description: The user’s link pages: for each its public address, name, line, link buttons in order, what it shows and whether it is live. Also how many pages the plan includes, and `kept`: what the service keeps current on every page without being asked (the look and logo from the brand, the open-now line from the brand’s hours, the connected accounts and the latest published posts). And `reserved`: addresses a page of theirs has left, which only they can use until the time given. The page that carries the user’s blog says so (showBlog) and where the blog is (blogAddress). On Studio and Pro each page has `stats` (null on Starter): visits and link clicks over the last 30 days, today included, and the clicks of each web link on it now (people’s browsers only, no cookies; a phone or email link is not counted). Use it to say which links people use.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.
